name: PinchRotate
summary: Left-hand pinch orbits the viewpoint around a polyhedron while a right-hand ray selects a face.
howItWorks: An eyeball-in-hand view control (the camera moves with the left hand) is combined with ray selection; the object keeps its shape. Tested with 16 participants selecting single faces on regular polyhedra (4, 6 or 12 faces, two sizes) with tracked hands.
limitations: Moving the viewpoint caused more dizziness and lower usability.

relationships.note: Introduced with seven other face-selection techniques in the same study.
The study's baseline (DragRotate) rotates the object with one hand and selects with a hand ray.
